prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic X/Twitter-style post screenshot showing an announcement about transparent image generation, with an embedded transparent-background sticker illustration.

Canvas: Square-ish social media screenshot, about 900 × 1090 px, white background, thin pale border on the far right, clean X/Twitter interface spacing.

Layout: At the top left place 1 circular profile avatar showing a smiling young man. To its right place the display name Tibo in bold black, followed by 1 blue verified check badge, with the handle @thsottiaux in gray underneath. At the top right place exactly 2 small interface icons: a black visibility/hidden-style icon and a gray three-dot overflow menu. Below the header, show exactly 2 text paragraphs: first an English paragraph, then a Chinese paragraph. Under the text, place 1 large rounded-corner embedded image card with a checkerboard transparency pattern background.

Text content: English paragraph: Yay, you can now make transparent images in ChatGPT and through the API with GPT-Image-2. Here is a cactus cactus I am about to print and put on my laptop. Chinese paragraph: 太棒了！现在你可以使用 ChatGPT 和 GPT-Image-2 API 制作透明图像了。\n这是我准备打印出来贴到笔记本电脑上的仙人掌图片。

Embedded illustration: Inside the image card, create exactly 1 cute kawaii cactus sticker centered on a transparent checkerboard background. The cactus has 1 large oval green central body with vertical ribbing and glossy highlights, exactly 2 curved side arms, black smiling eyes, a wide open happy mouth, rosy pink cheeks, many small cream-colored spines with peach bases, and a thick dark green outline. On top of the cactus place exactly 1 pink-red flower with 5 large rounded petals, yellow bead-like stamens in the center, and a dark outline. The cactus sits in exactly 1 orange terracotta flower pot with a rolled rim, glossy highlights, dark outline, and brown soil with several visible pebbles. Add a soft white sticker-like border around the cactus and pot so it looks printable for a laptop decal.

Visual style: High-resolution clean screenshot aesthetic, black and gray UI typography similar to X/Twitter, generous margins, playful glossy 3D cartoon sticker style for the cactus, saturated greens and oranges, crisp outlines, soft shading.

Constraints: Use exactly 1 embedded image card, exactly 1 cactus, exactly 2 cactus arms, exactly 1 flower, exactly 1 pot, exactly 2 post paragraphs, and exactly 2 top-right UI icons. Do not add likes, comments, timestamps, watermarks, or extra interface elements.

promptZh:
目标：创建一张逼真的 X/Twitter 风格帖子截图，展示关于透明图像生成的公告，并嵌入一张带有透明背景的贴纸插图。

画布：方形社交媒体截图，约 900 × 1090 像素，白色背景，最右侧有细淡边框，保持简洁的 X/Twitter 界面间距。

布局：左上角放置 1 个圆形个人资料头像，显示一名微笑的年轻人。其右侧放置加粗黑体的显示名称 Tibo，后跟 1 个蓝色认证徽章，下方为灰色的账号名 @thsottiaux。右上角放置 2 个小型界面图标：1 个黑色可见性/隐藏图标和 1 个灰色三点溢出菜单。在标题下方，显示 2 个文本段落：第一段为英文，第二段为中文。在文本下方，放置 1 张带有棋盘格透明图案背景的大型圆角嵌入式图像卡片。

文本内容：英文段落：Yay, you can now make transparent images in ChatGPT and through the API with GPT-Image-2. Here is a cactus cactus I am about to print and put on my laptop. 中文段落：太棒了！现在你可以使用 ChatGPT 和 GPT-Image-2 API 制作透明图像了。\n这是我准备打印出来贴到笔记本电脑上的仙人掌图片。

嵌入式插图：在图像卡片内，创建 1 个位于透明棋盘格背景中心的可爱 kawaii 风格仙人掌贴纸。仙人掌具有 1 个带有垂直纹理和光泽高光的大型椭圆形绿色主体，2 个弯曲的侧臂，黑色的笑眼，张开的快乐嘴巴，粉红色的脸颊，许多带有桃色基底的奶油色小刺，以及粗深绿色轮廓。仙人掌顶部放置 1 朵粉红色花朵，花朵有 5 片大圆花瓣，中心有黄色珠状雄蕊，并带有深色轮廓。仙人掌放置在 1 个带有卷边、光泽高光、深色轮廓的橙色陶土花盆中，花盆内有棕色土壤和几颗可见的鹅卵石。在仙人掌和花盆周围添加 1 个柔软的白色贴纸状边框，使其看起来像可打印的笔记本电脑贴纸。

视觉风格：高分辨率简洁截图美学，类似于 X/Twitter 的黑灰色 UI 排版，宽裕的边距，仙人掌采用俏皮的光泽 3D 卡通贴纸风格，饱和的绿色和橙色，清晰的轮廓，柔和的阴影。

约束：使用 1 张嵌入式图像卡片，1 个仙人掌，2 个仙人掌手臂，1 朵花，1 个花盆，2 个帖子段落，以及 2 个右上角 UI 图标。不要添加点赞、评论、时间戳、水印或额外的界面元素。
